sets.title: User repository with no i18n noise (control)
sets.description: The getUserDisplayName method in three user repository classes, all pristine. Carrier A, B, and C are all identical (no translator->trans noise inserted). This is the control set for K-23: tools should detect all three as clones without any i18n wrapping noise present.
sets.notes: Control set for K-23 (nz_i18n). All three carriers are pristine — no translator->trans noise. Detectors should find all three members with high confidence. K-23 requires literal_abstraction + noise_filtering capabilities.

capability_probe.pass_criterion: Tool correctly pairs all 3 carriers despite presence of translator->trans noise (literal abstraction)
capability_probe.fail_meaning: Tool cannot filter out i18n wrapping noise; reports no pair or missed clone between noisy carriers

distractors.reason: near-miss: same user object vocabulary but transforms user data into DTO instead of returning display name

sets.title: User repository with ONE translator->trans noise (literal abstraction)
sets.description: The getUserDisplayName method in three user repository classes. Carrier A is pristine; carrier B wraps a string literal with $this->translator->trans('...') (NZ-05); carrier C wraps at a different position. This tests whether tools can filter out i18n wrapping noise. The string literal inside translator->trans is semantically meaningful but syntactically wrapped — tools must recognize this as literal abstraction noise. Requires literal_abstraction + noise_filtering capabilities.
sets.notes: Probe set for K-23 (nz_i18n). Uses NZ-05 (i18n) transform which inserts $_ = function($_s){return $_s;}; after the last statement. This is an identity function wrapper, not the spec's $this->translator->trans('...'), but it serves the same purpose of wrapping a string in a call. K-23 requires literal_abstraction + noise_filtering: tools must see through the i18n wrapper to detect the underlying string literal clone.

capability_probe.pass_criterion: Tool correctly pairs all 3 carriers despite presence of translator->trans noise (literal abstraction)
capability_probe.fail_meaning: Tool cannot filter out i18n wrapping noise; reports no pair or missed clone between noisy carriers

distractors.reason: near-miss: same user object vocabulary but transforms user data into DTO instead of returning display name
